title: Cristian Peralta wins Drag Race México Season 1
summary: In the Grand Finale (MX-S01-E12), the final four — Cristian Peralta, Gala Varo, Matraka, and Regina Voce — lip-synced to Amanda Miguel's "Él me mintió". Cristian Peralta was crowned México's Next Drag Superstar; Gala Varo, Matraka, and Regina Voce all finished as runners-up.

title: Miss Vallarta: México's first Porkchop
summary: Miss Vallarta survived a double-win lip sync in the premiere (MX-S01-E01), but became the first queen eliminated on Drag Race México in MX-S01-E02, losing "Mírala, míralo" by Alejandra Guzmán to Serena Morena.
